title: Revenue Leakage Analysis: Framework for Prioritizing Fixes
description: A six-category revenue leakage analysis framework — acquisition, response, conversion, retention, billing, expansion — with prioritization matrix.

faq.a: A structured review of where money is lost across your customer journey, with dollar estimates so you fix high-impact leaks first.

faq.q: How often should you run leakage analysis?
faq.a: Quarterly for most SMBs, or after major funnel changes (new pricing, checkout, sales process).

blocks.text: Revenue leakage analysis turns vague frustration (“we should be doing better”) into a ranked backlog. Score each category 1–5 for severity, then multiply by estimated monthly dollars at risk.

items: Conversion — trials, demos, carts that stall
Billing — failed payments and invoice delays
Expansion — missed upsells and annual plans

blocks.text: Plot each leak on impact (monthly $) vs effort (time to fix). Quick wins in the high-impact / low-effort quadrant go first — often response time, dunning emails, or cart recovery.
Pair with [revenue leakage detection](/blog/revenue-leakage-detection) for measurement steps.

blocks.headline: Get a scored leakage report for your business
